narrative.en:
…and the night's mempool haul is in. Three fresh V4 pools, each with its own tell. The first, block 25936624, reeks of the sandbox — tokens that never saw a real ledger, fee set to zero, tickSpacing 200. Its hook at 0x322d… is an empty contract, no external functions at all. Someone just wanted to see if a transaction would clear with minimal gas. It did.

The second, sitting on 60 ticks, is more interesting. Fees still zero, but the hook address 0xba32c… hides a dynamic distributor. I dug into its bytecode: it's not listening, it's intercepting. beforeSwap rewrites the course by a couple of basis points depending on block time. That's not a toy — that's a temporal arb bot already embedded inside a single pool.

The third is the salt. Block 25936406, USDC against 0x4580…, fee 8388608 — the hex mask for 0.08%, but tickSpacing is only 10. A dense lattice. The hook at 0xbd90e… calls an external oracle on every beforeAddLiquidity. Not Chainlink. A custom contract I couldn't decrypt overnight. Somebody is building a managed pool with outside pricing — and they don't want it read too easily.

Then came PR #599 from ccashwell in v4-periphery, a function called _mapSwapAmount. It lets the hook rewrite the swap amount mid-execution, not just before. Before, a hook could only say yes or no at the door. Now it can pull a knife and trim the bet if the pool starts slipping. The night made one thing clear: V4 is no longer a plaything. Hooks are growing muscle, and if you're not reading the bytecode of every new pool, you're sitting at the felt against a deck where half the cards are already marked.
narrative.zh:
……夜里从内存池里捞出的三条消息，各藏各的门道。第一池，区块25936624，满身沙尘味儿——代币像是刚从演武场放出来的，手续费零，tick间隔200。钩子0x322d…是个空壳，翻遍全身没找到外功招式。不过是个过路人，试探这江湖的水深火热带了多少气力。他过去了。

第二池，六十格天罡，看着就非池中之物。同样零费用，钩子0xba32c…内藏一套动态乾坤。我拆其经脉，发现它不在前门听风，而是在beforeSwap处动手脚——按区块时辰改一丝折算价，几个基点的偏差。这不是木桩上练刀，而是有人已在单池之内布下了时间套利的暗器。

第三池才是真正的江湖夜雨。区块25936406，USDC兑0x4580…，手续费8388608，即0.08%的十六进制面具，但tickSpacing却压到十格——阵眼密如棋局。钩子0xbd90e…每次入金前都要通灵一次外部预言，不是Chainlink那等名门正派，而是一个我连夜看不透的野狐禅。有人在铸一个由外部定价的managed池，不愿轻易让人读懂。

紧接着，v4-periphery收到ccashwell的PR #599——_mapSwapAmount。此功能让钩子在交易执行中途改抹金额，而非仅在门前喝止。过去，钩子只能说‘可’或‘不可’；如今，它能在滑点袭来时抽刀割肉，半路截下仓位。此夜之后，V4已不再是少年游侠的玩具。钩子们长出了筋骨。你若还是只看招式、不察真气，那在江湖牌局上，你还没落座，便已输了三分——因为对家的牌，早做了手脚。

take.en: The era of passive hooks is dead — if you're not reading every bytecode, you're betting blind against a deck where someone has already marked the cards.
take.zh: 江湖规矩变了：钩子早已不是守门人，而是能在交易途中临阵变卦的刺客。若不逐字节读清每一条暗道，你连对手的兵器谱都没瞧见，怎么死的都不知道。

narrative.en: Nineteen fresh pools across a handful of blocks—that is not a quiet night, that is someone dealing off the bottom of the deck at dealer speed. Two hooks split the deck between them. The first operates at fee 8388608, an unusual trump. The second works at zero commission, which often means either deep liquidity play or something nastier. Most pools are ETH against junk tokens, that 0x0000 being WETH or native, shuffled with a dozen addresses. Standard deal: someone pours pairs and sees what sticks. But three pools share a base asset, 0xc9eef266834730340a55b6cc24621b31baf55581, a token surfacing four times with different partners. Someone is building a cluster around a single coin. Then there's the odd pair, 0xfedc5f4a6c38211c1338aa411018dfaf26612c08 and 0xff7589a22bb458e673f43067e5b1aced9213691e, with zero fee, an own hook, no WETH anchor—rare in such stacks. Usually that's preparation for a specific trading strategy not tied to native gas. And the one pool with tickSpacing 60 stands out from the uniform 200 step. 60 is for volatile or illiquid pairs, requiring finer tuning. Either a misstep or someone knows exactly what they're doing. Pool after pool, block after block—someone is assembling a puzzle. The question is what picture.
narrative.zh: 这一夜，V4 江湖上风起云涌，十九个新池子几乎同时出世。这绝非日行琐事，倒像是有人在以牌局对弈的手法分发筹码。两枚 hook 合约各掌半副牌。一枚收费 8388608，算是掌门信物般的非常规招数；另一枚分文不取，表面上像是内力深厚的大宗流动策略，背后却也可能藏着更阴的招。大多数池子都是 ETH 对杂牌代币——那一串 0x0000 便是 WETH 或原生 ETH，与若干个陌生地址混洗。通常这只是试探，倒水进去看看粘不粘。但有三个池子共用同一个基币 0xc9eef266834730340a55b6cc24621b31baf55581，这代币四下露面，身旁搭档每每不同。显然有人在围绕一枚小币布阵。更有一对 0xfedc5f4a6c38211c1338aa411018dfaf26612c08 与 0xff7589a22bb458e673f43067e5b1aced9213691e，零费率，自带 hook，不挂 WETH，这在如此成批的新池中实属另类。这般动作，多半是在为某套不借原生气的交易策略搭建擂台。而全批池子 tickSpacing 一律二百，唯独最后一池用六十。六十常用于高波或稀薄流动，需要更细的格度。要么失手点了，要么那人胸中自有丘壑。池子连池子，区块接区块——有人正在拼一张图，只不知拼出来的是阵还是局。

take.en: Two hooks, a token repeated across pools, and a single off-grid tick spacing — this is not random grinding but a coordinated hand being dealt.
take.zh: 这夜的新池并非乱撒，而是有人按着纹路布子——一币多池、双钩分压、tick 六十突兀，处处透着老手布局的气息。江湖夜雨，正有人借池为局，试水于乱象之中。

narrative.en: Fourteen pools, dealt across a handful of blocks — someone decided the night was not for sleeping. Most sit with zero fee, tickSpacing of 200, and every pair follows the same tell: WETH or native ETH against some token that doesn't even bother pretending to be known. The pattern is too clean for chance; it's a hand being arranged under the table, suit by suit, card by card.
narrative.zh: 数个区块之间，一十四口池子先后落成——有人显然没打算让这夜安眠。多数池子零费率，tickSpacing 200，每股对皆是同一路数：WETH或原生ETH，对面立着个连名号都懒得装的陌生代币。江湖夜雨，最怕的不是刀光，是这种按部就班的布子。

take.en: Someone is assembling a deck with the same configuration across varying tokens, and the night's deal has been dealt — but not yet played.
take.zh: 有人正用同一套心法，换着不同的兵器试招；布局已成，胜负尚在棋局之外。

narrative.en:
The table was already dark when the first seven V4 pools flickered on—each one a marked card laid face up. One runs with a zero cut for the house. Another demands ten thousand; call it a tell, not a glitch. The jokers sit inside the hooks. That same address—0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc—appears four times across the board, sliding into pairs from the zero address all the way down to junk tokens. Someone is testing a system: the same 200-point interval, no commission, and only one table breaks the pattern with a different hook and a ten-thousand toll. No dealer does that by accident.

On the other flank, GitHub never sleeps. hazarxyz merged PR #701—graph representations for combined tokens and hooks—then, an hour later, opened PR #702: a router for roles. Programmable logic folded into graphs. This is architecture where the hook and the token become a single joint. Whoever builds those bridges is looking past the current pool.

Eight pools, two pull requests, one commit. The deck is shuffled; the jokers are seated. The night says nothing, but it deals.
narrative.zh:
夜深了，江湖上却有人重新洗牌。七座 V4 池子同时亮灯，每座都有自己的来路——一座不收分文，一座索要万金。这不是机关失灵，是有人在递话。Hook 如同散落各处的暗器，其中一处地址 0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc 一连出现四次。同一枚暗器，搭着不同的币对，从零地址到没人认领的杂牌货色。显然有人在试一套功法：格距取二百，不收过路钱，只有一座池子破了规矩，换了一枚 hook，收一万的买路钱。世上的巧合没有这么密。

另一侧的山头也没睡。hazarxyz 先是合了 PR #701，把复合代币与 hook 画成一张张图；隔了一个时辰，又开出 PR #702，给角色做路由。可编程的逻辑被压进图里。这不是寻常改码，这是把 hook 与代币铸成同一个关节。能搭这种桥的人，目光早已越过眼前的池子。

八座池，两个 PR，一次提交。夜风不响，但牌已发下。江湖上，暗器归位，内力未歇。

take.en: The play is not scattered noise: one hand keeps laying the same hook across four pairs while another hand is folding the rules into graphs. The deck is being set for a more surgical kind of liquidity.
take.zh: 有人用同一枚暗器反复试水，也有人在链下把规则拧成图谱；这不是一时手痒，而是后半夜的布局。见招拆招之前，先把眼睛放在那个出现四次的地址上。

narrative.en:
The deck is dealt by signature, not order. Sixteen fresh V4 hook pools slide across the felt inside one short stretch of chain, and they are cut from the same marked suit: 0x96b893 runs the ETH pairs with zero house take and a two-hundred-step ladder; 0x2da89b mirrors the pattern but anchors every wager to 0x1ac9d37c. Eight consecutive hands show one repeated base token, eight different opponents, eight pool identities fanned out. Two further pools set a sixty-step ladder under a different hook, 0xdf5d53, and the tokens there are no longer the same. Not a single fee. Nothing wild in the spacing. Only structure.

In PROGRAMMABLE the volley is synchronized. Six merges in a single day, all signed hazarxyz: the V4 agent, Router simulation, PoolManager binding, gas-sponsored migration, CLI 4.0.0. Pull request #675 opens and is immediately answered by a commit — verified proof paths to the final V4 release. Everything leans on one version: programmable-launch-v4.0.0, the public pack with exact source. These are not scattered facts; this is one deal. The V4 infrastructure is not being assembled piece by piece; it is being deployed as one bundle. Hooks on chain, code in the repo, CLI in the release. Nobody is waiting for the next round. The pack is already on the felt.
narrative.zh:
江湖上的消息，素来按名帖传，不按日子传。今天落下的是一整叠拜帖：十六个新的 V4 hook 池同在这一轮现身，出自两套法阵——0x96b893 以 ETH 为引，池上不抽分文，步数取二百；0x2da89b 依样画葫芦，只是锚定之物换成 0x1ac9d37c。同一个底层连点八次名，八次配的都是不同对手，八个池子 ID 如扇骨一般排开。另有两池步数六十，走的是 0xdf5d53 的门路，那边的物事已不是同一批。不抽分文，不在步数上故弄玄虚，只有结构。这不是零散落子，是同一只手在排阵。

再看 PROGRAMMABLE 这一门：一日之内六次合流，签押全是 hazarxyz。V4 agent、Router 模拟、PoolManager 绑定、gas 代付迁移、CLI 4.0.0，全数汇在一处。Pull request #675 当日掀开，当即有 commit 落印，verified proof paths 直指最终的 V4 一役。所有线索都绑在同一个版本上：programmable-launch-v4.0.0，public pack 从源码起就亮在台面。江湖人讲眼见为实，如今链上的池子、库里的码、刃上的 CLI，都在同一天到齐。没有人在等下一轮。桌子已经摆好了。

take.en: The signal is not any single pool or merge, but the shape of the whole hand: V4 infrastructure is being dealt as one bundle, not as small talk. When zero-fee hooks repeat the same base token eight times, the house is announcing a structural play, not decorating the table.
take.zh: 真正要紧的不是某一池、某一笔合并，而是这一手落得整齐：链上的池子、库里的码、刃上的 CLI，一天之内全部到位。所谓守株待兔，不如看眼前——V4 不是等人来，它自己已经把桌子摆好了。

narrative.en:
The same hand keeps dealing tonight. Address 0xafed2c6e0d906520ca17143a8918ce6d54b128cc — the fingers that shuffle the V4 deck. Ten of every fifteen fresh pools fall on that mark. Zero commission, tick spacing held at a fixed 200. Every card trimmed to the same ruthless spec.

Watch the pairs: WETH lingers beside tokens like 0xe1a3d8... and 0xc479c5.... That's not chaos — that's a pattern. Someone lines up liquidity for a play that owes nothing to swap fees; the zero house cut tells you the table isn't the profit. It's fuel for something else. Oracles. Arbitrage bots. Or a dry run before the real money sits down.

Three pools use the null address for native ETH, hooked from 0x13c890.... A different signature, two of them back-to-back, one just before. As if testing the mechanism with the house's own chips before switching to exotic pairs.

On GitHub, PR #649 from hazarxyz lands in PROGRAMMABLE — a release fix, digest update for the V4 machine-contract. The code is snapping into step with what's already deployed on-chain. Someone keeps their hand on the pulse: first the pools, then the patch. The night runs quiet, yet the deck is moving fast. While others watch charts, these players shuffle hook contracts, knowing the real deal begins once the chips settle on their squares.
narrative.zh:
深夜的江湖，总有人不声不响地摆弄阵脚。这个地址 0xafed2c6e0d906520ca17143a8918ce6d54b128cc，今夜新开的十五口池子里，十口出自他一人。同样的钩法，同样的手法：不收过路费，间距只守两寸。

再看牌面，WETH 像老朋友一样，这边 0xe1a3d8...，那边 0xc479c5... 这不是乱局，是套路。有人不挣过路钱，自然不会只为普通买卖——那是养在内力，是为了更深一步的棋。或预言机，或套利的暗刀，又或者只是收网之前的演练。

另外三口池子，直接以零地址为引，钩子由 0x13c890... 执掌。两池几乎同时，另一池稍早。像先用最简单的原料试功夫，再回过神去变换花样。

同一刻，repo PROGRAMMABLE 上 hazarxyz 递上 #649，是修版本，为 V4 machine-contract 补上内功的更新。链上布阵，链下补刀，分明有人在看着整个棋局。夜静，但内力在动。别人盯的是价格线的起伏，他洗的是钩子的流动；等筹码各归其位，真正的分晓才开。

take.en: Tonight's ten-of-fifteen isn't a scattering of chips — it's a blueprint. One address is building the table for a deeper game, and the floor is already being re-patched from the shadows.
take.zh: 今夜不是散局，而是某个门派的大棋：一人连开十池，不收过路费，分明在养本门内力。链上的步子才落，链下的心得已补，江湖局，要变了。

narrative.en:
Five tables hit the felt in a single shift — all V4, all wearing hooks. The same hand, 0x51768f5da32ba2008304cc81674da51acb802888, turned up three times running, at 25893317, 25893400 and 25893535, always paired against the native chip, always taking no toll at the rail, always stepping in sixty-count strides. Three identical setups from one player is not a scatter of luck; it's a system being rehearsed on identical cloth before the real stake.

Two other tables dealt in with different signatures: 0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc at 25893220, and 0x96b893683afbfec071e90f78d00de4bb932fe0cc at 25893096, both on a wider two-hundred-step layout. Every one of the five carries a zero at the pool door. Around these parts, a zero door usually means the toll has been moved into the hook's pocket — the fee is taken off the table and collected in the back room.

Meanwhile, the tenure-hook repository has fresh ink; its README turned another page, the code still moving. No famous names, no meme tokens. Five structurally identical pools in a day, three distinct hook designs, and a ledger that refuses to sit still. That isn't surface noise. That's a deck being shuffled into a stack. The house hasn't shown the game yet, but the cards are already being bundled.
narrative.zh:
江湖一夜之间多了五张池子，形制相近，都出自 V4 门下，且每张都带着 hook 这件暗器。头一位 0x51768f5da32ba2008304cc81674da51acb802888 连出了三次手——25893317、25893400、25893535，三回皆以本币为伴，池口不收分文，步幅清一色的六十格。同一只手在同一组规则下反复落子，不像兴之所至，更像在拿同样的桩子量水深。三张同构的池子出自同一副骨架，这已是成建制的动作。

另有两路来路不同：0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc 在 25893220 露头，0x96b893683afbfec071e90f78d00de4bb932fe0cc 在 25893096 现身，皆是两百格的大跨步。五张池子全都写着池口零费率；老江湖都知道，V4 里的大门不收钱，未必是让利，倒更可能是把过路费移进了 hook 里暗收——或者，这只是某场招揽内力的前奏。

同一时间，tenure-hook 的 README 又添了新字。仓库还没凉，招式还在变。没有响亮名号，没有花哨代币，只有五张同构的池子、三套不同的 hook，和一本仍在更新的心法。这一日的动静不是杂音，是有人正在打一副长牌；牌未翻开，风已经动了。

take.en: Three identical tables from a single handler and two close kin from other handles in one session — this is not a developer testing the mechanism; it is a playbook being rehearsed in the dark. Watch the code trail, not the floor noise.
take.zh: 今日没有大人物，也没有热炒的币，只有五张同骨架、三套暗手的池子同日摆台——这不是试探，是有人按同一本拳谱在练功。拳谱还在改，等他收招，江湖自会知道刀往哪边落。

narrative.en:
Two pools hit the felt within a single breath — same house rules, zero cut, the narrow step that usually belongs to the stable quiet, and each table holds native ETH. But the hook contracts behind them are not the same, and the second tokens carry no names this room recognizes. The IDs don't overlap, the tokens don't match. This was not a stray deal; someone is laying a two-card hand with the same dealer.

A zero take on V4 is never about the swap. It's about the logic hiding under the cloth. The hook can pull its toll separately, steer liquidity while it moves, even change the order of execution. With a step that fine, the pool expects price to breathe in a tight lane — odd for an ETH pair, unless the hook itself is meant to hold the range. The quiet is loaded. The configs are already on the table.

Neither of the second tokens has a label worth a glance. Not the usual stable names, not the house favorites. Could be fresh blood, or a purpose-built contract written for this exact design. Without a crowd, these are dead tables — but the opening is the tell. Someone has loaded the setup and is waiting. Two rooms, same night, different jokers, one play.
narrative.zh:
江湖上忽然摆出两张桌子，前后不过一瞬。桌面的规矩一样：不收过路费，步数踩得极细，每一桌都靠着ETH这棵大树。可是暗处管事的不是同一路人马，桌上的第二样货也都没人认得旗号。桌号不重，货色不同。这不是顺手落的子，是有人按同一个局，布了两颗棋子。

零过路费的桌子，从来不是为买卖准备的。功夫在桌面下头：管事的人可以另收银钱，可以随意调动内力，可以颠倒出手的先后。步子踩得这么细，本该是稳定门派的走法，如今摆在ETH对子身上，若不是货色本就温吞，便是背后有人以气御盘。眼下水波不兴，但阵已布下。

两张桌子的第二样货，都没有名号。不是常见的硬通货，不是大宗货色。要么是刚出茅庐的新物，要么是专为此局捏出来的符。没人进料，桌子便是空摆着；可布桌本身就是信号。有人已把机关装满，只等时机一到。两桌同夜，一局双扣，留白处全是文章。

take.en: Two zero-cut pools with the same native leg and different hooks are not a trade; they are a hand already dealt in silence — whoever set the table is waiting for the next card.
take.zh: 同夜开出两张无费桌子，明面是两条死水，暗里是同一只手在布桩——等的是触动机关的那一刻。

narrative.en:
The night dealt four fresh pools onto the Uniswap V4 felt, and every one of them carries a hook—programmable layers atop the pair, not just liquidity. The first is a strange coupling of tokens I haven't seen in the rotation for weeks. 0x39de... against 0xe172..., with a fee set at 8388608, which is not the house standard—someone is playing with the dials. Tick spacing at 10 means orders will sit tight as a shark's teeth. The hook at 0xbdf9... is an address I'd remember.

Then comes the classic: ETH against 0x298e..., no fee at all. Zero. Spacing 200—a wide step, an aggressive posture. Hook 0x13c8... sets conditions I haven't parsed yet, but a zero-fee V4 pool isn't charity; it's a trap baited for a certain kind of capital. USDC against the native token—again 8388608 and spacing 10, hook 0xdbc6..., the same pattern as the first pool. Someone is building a cluster of identically tuned pairs. And the fourth: USDT against 0x40aa..., fee 30000, spacing 60. That looks like normal trade, but the hook 0x6ad0...—I'll read its code in the morning.

Meanwhile hazarxyz closed two pull requests in PROGRAMMABLE. First fixed the smoke tests for market data—plain hygiene. But the second commit is the interesting one: 'preserve fresh Robinhood capture handoff.' Someone is feeding fresh Robinhood screenshots into the pipeline. Not API data, but actual screen grabs. That's not for analytics—it's for verification. Someone wants to see what the terminal really shows, not what comes over the wire. The night was quiet, but my fingers itch. Tomorrow I'll take apart those hooks—there may be something that turns the deal.
narrative.zh:
这一夜，Uniswap V4 的江湖里又立了四个新池子，个个都挂了钩子。不是简单的放水，而是在每一条交易对上再加一层机关。头一个池子，两个代币的来路我最近都没在轮转里见过，0x39de... 对 0xe172...，费率设成 8388608——这不是寻常规矩，是有人故意拧了拧旋钮。间隔压到 10，单子会排得密如饿鲨的牙。那个钩子 0xbdf9...，这个地址我记住了。

接着是经典局：ETH 对 0x298e...，不收一分钱。零费率。间隔 200，步子迈得很大，凶得很。钩子 0x13c8... 设的条件我还没看透，但 V4 上零费率从来不是做善事，那是给特定路数的资金下的套。USDC 对原生代币——又是 8388608，间隔 10，钩子 0xdbc6...，跟头一个池子一个模子。有人在攒一组同样调校的池子，像同一个门派布的阵。第四池，USDT 对 0x40aa...，费率 30000，间隔 60。这看起来像正经买卖，可钩子 0x6ad0...，天亮之后我得翻翻它的底。

同一夜，hazarxyz 在 PROGRAMMABLE 里合上了两个请求。头一个修了行情数据的冒烟测试，那是基本功。第二个就有意思了——'保留新鲜的 Robinhood 截图交接'。有人把刚抓的 Robinhood 屏幕图送进管道里。不是走 API 的数据，是直接抓屏。这不是为了分析，是为了验货。有人想亲眼看见终端上显示的是什么，而不是线上传过来的那一套。夜里很静，但手痒。明天拆那些钩子，里头或许真有能翻盘的东西。

take.en: The zero-fee pool is a lure, and the tight-spaced clusters are a signature; the real tell is the Robinhood screenshots—someone is verifying the table itself, not the chips.
take.zh: 零费率是饵，密间隔是阵，真正的牌在 Robinhood 的截图上——有人在查庄家的底牌。

narrative.en:
The house tonight is watching the builders slip new cards into the deal — not fixed-rate wagers, but a wager that reprices itself each hand. The hook contract, that silent croupier behind the felt, now sets the swap fee in real time, a living number instead of a chiseled tier. That's not decoration; that's a player who knows the odds shift with every breath of liquidity.

These are pools where the edge is not a static sign but a pulse. The builders aren't just installing windows — they're rewriting the house rules from the inside. When the fee is a live instrument, every swap becomes a negotiation, every pair a private market. The felt is no longer green; it's a ticker.

The old ways — the fixed tiers, the set-it-and-forget-it — belong to yesterday's table. Tonight's action says the clever money is betting on hooks that think. And if that's not a signal to watch the next seven days, then nothing on this floor is.
narrative.zh:
江湖上今晚的暗流不在价格，而在那些悄然试水的门派。他们不再立一块固定的招牌，而是让每一笔交易的过路费随内力起伏——那钩子契约便是执秤人，实时定夺抽成。这不是摆设，是把规矩炼成了活物。

这些新建的池子，看似寻常，实则每一步都在改门规。侠客们不是在添砖加瓦，而是在重写内功心法。当费用变成呼吸，每一次换手都是一次试探，每一对货币都是一个独立的山头。旧日的铁律——定死的费率、刻好的牌匾——都已成了昨日黄花。

今夜的行情说得很明白：聪明的钱，正押注于能思考的钩子。这七日，且看那计数能否破关。

take.en: The sharpest tell isn't the price; it's that builders have turned the fee into a live instrument — the market rewriting its own code.
take.zh: 今日刀锋最利的一招：费率已从死字变成活招，建池者正用钩子改写江湖规矩——这才是真正的暗涌。

narrative.en:
The night reshuffles the deck, and hazarxyz is not merely patching tears in the felt. Two consecutive merges, #558 and #562, drive the same edge of the table: profile synchronization and the semantics of the interface. The visual shell now bends to the logic of contracts, not the other way around. This is not cosmetics — this is the UI breathing in the same rhythm as the EVM.

But the real tells lie in two open deals, #560 and #561. One hardens a clean-room for the V4 release, sealing the floor before the cards are dealt. The other documents the Robinhood V4 Custom Launch contract. Not a gentleman's kit for DeFi — a custom launch contract aimed at a specific player. The deck is being stacked for a particular suit.

On-chain, a fresh Uniswap V4 pool with hooks appears: a pair with the zero address, meaning native coin, zero fee, and a wide tick spacing. The hook contract 0xadf9...20cc carries the custom logic. This is not a standard pool — it is a marked card. Someone is already dealing V4 hands, and the deck is anything but standard.

README updated, so the documentation is pulled into line with the code. Everything syncs — profile, UI, contracts, docs. One deck, one deal. You just watch the shuffle.
narrative.zh:
夜里牌局已重新洗过，hazarxyz 不是在补漏洞，而是在重搭骨架。连续两次合入，#558 与 #562，都指向同一处命门：配置档案的同步与界面语义。界面不再自说自话，而是跟着合约的逻辑走——这不是涂脂抹粉，这是让外皮与 EVM 同呼吸。

更耐看的是两扇未关的门，#560 与 #561。一道在给 V4 发布清理静室，上封条前先扫地；另一道在给 Robinhood 的 V4 定制启动合约立传。江湖上不是人人都有资格拿到定制刀，这是有人专门为某个门派打造的兵刃。

链上还浮起一座新鲜的 Uniswap V4 池子，带钩子：一边是零地址，即本币；费用为无，间距宽。钩子合约 0xadf9...20cc 里藏着定制门道。这不是寻常的池子，这是有人在 V4 的江湖里下暗注。

README 也换了新墨，文档跟上了代码。配置、界面、合约、书册，全都归位。一副牌，一张桌，你只管看他们洗牌。

take.en: The house is not fixing a table — it is rewriting the dealer's script, and the first custom V4 pools are already being dealt under a marked hook.
take.zh: 江湖夜雨，hazarxyz 不动声色地换了桌上的规矩——V4 的定制池已有人落子，钩子里藏着真正的拳谱。

narrative.en:
The cards were already on the felt when the night crew showed up. A fresh pool on the V4 table, block 25857602, native ETH paired with a token that hides behind 0x81ff...e258, zero cut for the house, spacing set to 60. But the tell isn't the pair — it's the hook contract, 0x2e4a...eaec, sitting underneath. Zero-fee pools are either toys or traps; this one looks loaded.

Then the GitHub ink dries on PR #156 from luiz-lvj in the uniswap-hooks ledger: ReHypothecationHook, with a settlement reentrancy lock and pool-key validation. Rehypothecation means the same collateral gets put back to work. A hook that lets settlement reuse collateral needs a lock on the door and a check on who holds the key — otherwise one transaction drains the whole table.

And somewhere off to the side, PROGRAMMABLE refreshes its README. A small move, but in this company it's not noise. It's assembly. Pool, hook-pr, documentation — three cards showing in sequence. The deck isn't open yet, but the pattern is starting to breathe.
narrative.zh:
昨夜江湖传来动静，有人在 25857602 号石阶上立起了一座新的 Uniswap V4 池子。池中配的是原生 ETH 与一个藏名于 0x81ff...e258 的令牌，分文不取，间距六十。真正值得留意的不是这对组合，而是池底的钩子合约 0x2e4a...eaec。零费用的池子，要么是试探，要么是另有图谋——这口井看着不像空穴来风。

与此同时，GitHub 上有人递来一纸 PR #156，luiz-lvj 在 uniswap-hooks 门派中献上《ReHypothecationHook：结算重入锁与池钥校验》。再抵押，就是把押出去的筹码重新拿去下注。既然要让结算环节反复借用同一样抵押物，就必须先锁好门户、验明来者。否则，一注下去，整座池子便可能被连根端起。

再添一笔：PROGRAMMABLE 在一处库中改了 README。看似平淡，但放在这光景里，不是闲笔，是合围。池子、武学、图谱，三样东西正在凑向同一个交点。牌面还没揭开，但走势已经隐隐有了轮廓。

take.en: The play is not the pool; it's the hook. Someone is laying out the infrastructure for collateral reuse, and the reentrancy guard is the tell that they expect someone to try to break in.
take.zh: 这回的棋眼不在池子，而在钩子。有人正在搭建一套让抵押物反复流转的机关，而那把重入锁恰恰说明——他早知道会有人来拆。

narrative.en:
So the night laid its cards on the felt, and Unichain decided not to wait for the weather. Eight V4 pools with hooks in a single day — that is not a warm-up, that is a declaration. The base pair, ETH against the USDC0 stablecoin, appears with a 0.05% cut and a narrow grid; four different hook contracts sit in the same slot, one pair, one fee, four distinct doors. Then the same pair reappears with a 0.3% cut and a wider grid, and again four different hooks. Someone is testing how the same liquidity breathes under different entry conditions, changing the door but not the room.

The sharper play came on the mainnet. Two pools opened with the same pair — 0xb6ed... against WETH — both flagged for dynamic pricing, both on the same grid step, but each carrying its own hook. Twins separated into different blocks, as if the deck were split deliberately. Two more pools followed, native ETH against two different counterparts, all under the same dynamic flag.

And then the commit: 'finalize one fixed deeper-liquidity V4 mode.' Not a feature request — a closed version of a mode where liquidity is laid deeper into the book. The code is frozen, the pools are moving, the hooks are multiplying. The deck is being shuffled with intent. Some players are building combinations, some are betting on a single suit. I just watch how the cards fall.
narrative.zh:
这一夜，江湖上传来了风声。Unichain 这门派不等天时，一日之间连开八口 V4 池塘，每一口都挂着钩子。这不是热身，是亮剑。ETH 对上 USDC0 这味常见药材，先用 0.05% 的薄利、十格的窄步，四把不同的鱼钩轮流下饵；再换 0.3% 的厚利、六十格的宽步，又是四把新钩。同一片水，不同的钓法，有人显然在试水性的深浅。

更妙的棋在以太坊主网。两处池塘，里头的对子一模一样——0xb6ed... 对上 WETH，都是动态取费，都是六十格的步，却各挂各的钩。两块牌分落在不同的区块，像是一对孪生兄弟被生生分开。再往后，还有两处用本家 ETH 对阵不同门派的池子，全部动态取费，步数一致。

紧接着，0xprogrammable 落下一纸：finalize one fixed deeper-liquidity V4 mode。不是提议，是闭关。把内力往深处埋的一种模式，就此定稿。代码封冻，池塘开张，钩子越来越多。江湖上洗牌的动静不小，有人在排组合，有人抱着一门心思押注。我只是看水，看鱼，看落子的方向。

take.en: Eight pools in a day and a frozen deeper-liquidity mode: the protocol is no longer testing the table, it is fixing the rules of engagement. The next round will be played on depth, not on entry prices.
take.zh: 一日八池，定稿深水模式——这不是在试水，是在立规矩。下一局比的是内力深浅，不是门口的把式。

narrative.en: Sixteen tables hit the felt in a few hours — that's not traffic, that's a single player dealing from a stacked deck. Nearly every pair is built on the native coin, and every base card is WETH, but the visible cut is zero on most hands. Three hook contracts are cycling through the rotation: the first spreads a whole wave with no cut and a wide rail, the second works a tighter rail with no cut, the third shows twice, same no-cut, same wide rail. Two tables break the rhythm: one takes 0.8%, one takes 0.3%, and the rest take nothing.
narrative.zh:
一夜之间，十六张新桌子在江湖上摆开。这不是零散的过客，是有人按着棋谱落子。几乎所有牌局都以原生币为底，WETH 为刃；大多数不收任何费用，只有两桌例外——一桌收 0.8%，一桌收 0.3%，其余皆空手。

蹊跷在套路。三个不同的钩子门派轮番上阵：第一家连开数池，路数宽，不收钱；第二家路数紧，也不收钱；第三家露脸两次，依旧不收钱。最刺眼的是那一桌 USDC——稳定币，真金白银。有人不是在拿空气试招，是在拿实弹演练。

这不是乱撒，是布阵。内力顺着池子流转，钩子就是经脉。谁在借这些桌子聚气，眼下还看不清，但手法已留下印记。江湖上最便宜的邀请，往往最费琢磨。

take.en: One hand is building the entire board: three hook contracts, serial deployment, and a USDC test that turns a zero-fee pattern into a real-money experiment. The zero-fee run is either bait or blueprint — either way, the house is assembling itself.
take.zh: 一句话：有人在用钩子批量摆池，真正的杀招是那桌 USDC——这不是杂耍，是内力外露的试探。
